name: bedroom-fit
description: Check beds, wardrobes and bedside reach.

interface.longDescription: Check beds, wardrobes and bedside reach. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Measure space around a bed; Check wardrobe opening depth; Compare bedside heights. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me measure space around a bed.
Help me check wardrobe opening depth.

prompts: Help me measure space around a bed.
Help me check wardrobe opening depth.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Rest Nest: Bedroom Layout workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Measure space around a bed. Reproducible inputs: {"width_cm":360,"depth_cm":400,"bed_width_cm":160,"bed_depth_cm":200,"bed_x_cm":100,"bed_y_cm":20}
positive.prompt: Help me measure space around a bed with these supplied values: {"width_cm":360,"depth_cm":400,"bed_width_cm":160,"bed_depth_cm":200,"bed_x_cm":100,"bed_y_cm":20}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses bedroom_fit_bed_clearances with the supplied inputs. Returns {"left_cm":100,"right_cm":100,"head_cm":20,"foot_cm":180,"inside_room":true,"width_cm":360,"depth_cm":400,"room_area_m2":14.4,"items":[{"name":"Bed","width_cm":160,"depth_cm":200,"x_cm":100,"y_cm":20}]}. Shows the actual room result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Check wardrobe opening depth. Reproducible inputs: {"distance_to_obstacle_cm":120,"door_projection_cm":50,"standing_space_cm":60}
positive.prompt: Help me check wardrobe opening depth with these supplied values: {"distance_to_obstacle_cm":120,"door_projection_cm":50,"standing_space_cm":60}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses bedroom_fit_wardrobe_opening with the supplied inputs. Returns {"space_after_door_cm":70,"fits_chosen_standing_space":true,"deficit_cm":0}. Shows the actual measurement result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare bedside heights. Reproducible inputs: {"mattress_top_cm":58,"available_width_cm":55,"options":[{"name":"Low table","height_cm":45,"width_cm":50},{"name":"Tall table","height_cm":60,"width_cm":60}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare bedside heights with these supplied values: {"mattress_top_cm":58,"available_width_cm":55,"options":[{"name":"Low table","height_cm":45,"width_cm":50},{"name":"Tall table","height_cm":60,"width_cm":60}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses bedroom_fit_bedside_height with the supplied inputs. Returns {"options":[{"name":"Low table","height_cm":45,"width_cm":50,"height_difference_cm":-13,"fits_width":true},{"name":"Tall table","height_cm":60,"width_cm":60,"height_difference_cm":2,"fits_width":false}]}. Shows the actual bars result. Does not fabricate external data.
